description: This file contains utility functions for converting between hex, base64, and byte arrays, used in the context of the SRP authentication project.

methods.name: hexDigitToInt
methods.description: Converts a single hex digit character to its integer value.

methods.name: t_fromhex
methods.description: Converts a hex string to a byte array.

methods.name: t_tohex
methods.description: Converts a byte array to a hex string.

methods.name: t_fromb64
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into a byte array.

methods.name: t_tob64
methods.description: Encodes a byte array into a base64 string.
